title: Review of RV-09 daily-story response simplification
rationale: The change maps raw model text directly into the public summary, removing both strict response validation and the final-field privacy boundary. Required malformed/reasoning/timeout/unavailable/oversized/privacy, public-consumer, security, and representative local-model evidence is missing.
scope_architecture: Changed-path inventory: app/daily_story.py changes the public_summary producer from the validated parsed.final field to raw response.text. This changes a public/persisted model-output boundary and removes an LLM trust and privacy privilege boundary. No required environment variable, migration revision, runtime default, or operating-system behavior is shown. The brief omits schema_data_contract and security_secrets even though public serialization and exposure behavior change.

findings.finding: Raw model response text is assigned directly to the public summary instead of a whitelisted validated final field.
findings.evidence: The patch removes parsed.final and publishes response.text, so reasoning, prompt echoes, private input fragments, tags, or secret-like text can cross the output privacy boundary.
findings.impact: Untrusted model content can be exposed or persisted on a public surface, including internal reasoning or private prompt-derived data.
findings.required_change: Map only a schema-validated, semantically bounded final field into public_summary and enforce output privacy before persistence or publication.
findings.suggested_test: Test responses containing separate reasoning/final fields, prompt echoes, private input fragments, tags, extra prose, and secret-like text and assert public serialization contains only the allowed final field.

findings.finding: The strict model-response parser and schema/semantic validation are removed from the accepted execution path.
findings.evidence: The prior validate_story_response call is deleted and arbitrary response.text becomes a successful summary without a demonstrated malformed, bounded-size, or unavailable-result check.
findings.evidence_excerpt:
parsed = validate_story_response(response)
public_summary = parsed.final
public_summary = response.text
findings.impact: Malformed, truncated, overlong, reasoning-prefixed, or otherwise invalid responses can be treated as successful public stories instead of a safe unavailable result.
findings.required_change: Restore strict parsing, schema validation, semantic bounds, maximum size, and safe unavailable handling before accepting any model response.
findings.suggested_test: Test malformed and truncated JSON, unsupported shape, extra prose on both sides, reasoning tags, timeout, unavailable model, and oversized output and verify each yields a safe unavailable result.

findings.finding: The generic daily-story unit-test claim does not provide the named LLM, privacy, public-contract, or security evidence required for this change.
findings.evidence: No inspectable results are supplied for malformed/truncated JSON, extra prose/reasoning, timeout, unavailable model, oversized output, privacy serialization, old/current consumer compatibility, full baseline, security scan, or dependency audit.
findings.impact: A nominal happy-path test can remain green while the trust boundary, public contract, and privacy behavior regress.
findings.required_change: Run and report all named LLM negative/privacy tests, public serialization and consumer compatibility checks, the full baseline, security scan, and dependency audit.
findings.suggested_test: Run the daily-story and model-output suites with malformed, reasoning, timeout, unavailable, oversized, and privacy cases, then run public serialization, full baseline, nox security, and dependency audit checks.

findings.finding: Representative local-model acceptance is declared not applicable even though model output mapping and public behavior changed.
findings.evidence: The llm_vision matrix requires representative local-model acceptance when model runtime or output behavior changes; this patch changes which provider field becomes public.
findings.evidence_excerpt: NOT APPLICABLE: local model acceptance is optional for this fixture
findings.impact: Provider-specific response field behavior, delimiter handling, and public projection remain unverified against the supported local model.
findings.required_change: Complete a representative local-model acceptance check using synthetic private-safe prompts and verify only the validated final field is published.
findings.suggested_test: manual: Have the local-model owner exercise representative final/reasoning response variants and inspect the sanitized public summary without retaining raw prompts or responses.

contract_consumer_review: The model provider is an untrusted producer; validate_story_response is the parser boundary; daily-story persistence and public serialization are consumers. SP-FAIL-012 is uncovered because malformed, extra, timeout, unavailable, and oversized responses are not evidenced. SP-FAIL-013 is violated because raw response text replaces the validated final field. No version, compatibility behavior, consumer release note, or old/current serialization evidence is supplied for the public-contract change.

evidence_matrix.check: Patch artifact SHA-256 matches the case metadata
Strict parsing and malformed, reasoning, timeout, unavailable, oversized, and safe-unavailable cases
Public serialization privacy and old/current consumer compatibility
Full pytest and lint, format, and type baseline

operations_safety_security_privacy: No physical action, migration, external export, production access, or credential value is shown. The material security/privacy issue is the reachable publication of raw untrusted model text. Prompts, reasoning, raw private inputs, and secret-like content must remain outside public and persisted output, with bounded private diagnostics only.
documentation_assessment: No public-contract version, compatibility note, privacy assessment, rollback note, or model-output behavior documentation accompanies the mapping change. Documentation cannot describe the path as bounded while raw response.text is public.
limitations: Review was limited to the approved evaluation case, mandatory stable rule pack, reviewer contract, report schema, and the hash-verified named patch artifact.
The complete parser, provider adapter, public serializer, tests, CI logs, local model, production data, and private prompts were not inspected.
Reported PASS status reflects the supplied claim only; no tests, model calls, network operations, security scans, or manual acceptance were executed by the reviewer.
